sn48.51:1.5: The five faculties are “qualities on the side of awakening” (_bodhipakkhiyā dhammā_) because they lead to awakening ([sn48.51:2.6]()). This term is used repeatedly in this Saṁyutta in this sense. Outside of this context, it is used occasionally in the general sense of meditative development, without further specification ([an5.56:3.1]()). In three instances it is extended to “seven” such qualities ([dn27:30.5](), [iti82:3.1](), [iti97:4.2]()), which the commentary identifies with the seven sets of dhammas totaling 37 (rather than the seven awakening factors alone). We also find the synonymous phrase _sambodhipakkhika_ at [an9.1](). At [thag16.9:9.2]() these are connected with the “skilful” principles, suggesting we should relate this to the expression “on the side of good” or “on the side of bad”. The qualities “on the side of awakening” can be understood as opposing those ‘on the side of Māra” ([thag4.4:1.2]()).
